newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Sentron wins $1.7 million in orders.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Sentron wins $1.7 million in orders.

text.p: Thermo Sentron Inc said Thursday it received a series of orders from an industrial group in Taiwan and a steel producer in the United Kingdom worth a total of $1.7 million.
The company said it plans to ship weighing and inspection equipment later this year for use in a coal-fired power plant in Taiwan as part of a contract valued at $1.1 million.
Thermo Sentron will also deliver weighing and control systems worth more than $600,000 to the unidentified British steelmaker.
Thermo Sentron makes precision-weighing and inspection equipment and control systems.
Its shares were up 1/4 Thursday at 9-5/8.
